up: Retrieve distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL1936 (Mast/stem cell growth factor receptor Kit). Filter on assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and return only the distinct molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles columns.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
